headline: Twenty-one under the thinning cover.
body: The air has risen to twenty-one degrees beneath mostly cloudy skies. Southwest wind has strengthened to twenty-one kilometres an hour. Pressure near one thousand twenty continues a slight fall; streets stay dry under full daylight.
